recognize_zh: 第一次皮膚切片是 CD20+、EBER+ 的中大型 B 細胞增生，夾雜 CD3+ T 細胞；復發切片則換成 CD20−、EBER−、PD1+/CD3+ 的中小型淋巴球，顯示 EBV+ 大 B 細胞增生掩蓋了底下的濾泡輔助 T 細胞淋巴瘤（TFH lymphoma）。
features: Panel A: dense nodular dermal lymphoid infiltrate at low power
Panels B-F (first biopsy): medium to large atypical lymphocytes, CD20-positive with EBER-positive nuclei, interspersed CD3-positive T cells, high Ki-67
Panel G: recurrent diffuse dermal infiltrate at low power
Panels H-L (second biopsy): small to medium lymphocytes negative for CD20 and EBER, diffusely PD1-positive with CD3 positivity (inset) and high Ki-67
Loss of the B-cell/EBV component in the relapse biopsy (post-rituximab treatment effect)
describe_en: The initial skin biopsy shows a dense dermal infiltrate of medium to large atypical lymphocytes that are CD20 positive and EBER positive, with interspersed CD3-positive T cells and a high Ki-67 proliferation index. The subsequent skin biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of small to medium lymphocytes that are negative for CD20 and EBER, and positive for PD1 and CD3, again with high Ki-67. Shared TRG rearrangement and TET2/DNMT3A/RHOA G17V mutations link the two biopsies. Findings are consistent with follicular helper T-cell lymphoma whose initial presentation was obscured by a prominent EBV-positive large B-cell proliferation.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: EBV+ DLBCL lacks an underlying PD1/CXCL13-positive clonal T-cell population and RHOA G17V/TET2 mutations, which were demonstrated here.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: This shows PD1-positive small/medium T cells with low Ki-67 and localized lesions, rather than widespread disease with high proliferation and TFH-associated mutations.
MF shows epidermotropism of CD4-positive T cells and lacks the EBV-positive B-blast component and RHOA G17V mutation typical of TFH lymphoma.
THRLBCL has scattered large B cells in a background of non-clonal CD8-rich T cells and histiocytes, without PD1-positive clonal TFH cells.

stain: H&E, IHC: CD20, CD3, PD1, Ki-67, ISH: EBER
